title: Vaccinations for Tanzania: What to Discuss With Your Doctor
excerpt: Which vaccinations do you need for Tanzania? An overview of what to discuss with your doctor or travel clinic.
body:
Health advice for Tanzania depends on your personal situation and travel plans. Always consult your doctor or a travel clinic, ideally six to eight weeks before departure.

## Commonly discussed vaccinations

- Routine vaccinations (such as DTP and MMR).
- Hepatitis A.
- Typhoid, depending on travel style.
- Hepatitis B for some travellers.
- Rabies for longer stays or certain activities.

## Yellow fever

Tanzania may require a yellow fever certificate if you arrive from or transit through a country with yellow fever risk. Check current requirements for your route.

## Malaria

Malaria occurs in many parts of Tanzania. Discuss prevention with your doctor. See [malaria in Tanzania](/blog/malaria-tanzania/).

## In the Netherlands and Belgium

Municipal health services (GGD) and travel clinics give personal advice.

## Medication

Bring a travel kit with your own medication and copies of prescriptions.

This article is general information, not medical advice. See [staying healthy on safari](/blog/safari-health-tips/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
